title: Two Witnesses, One Room. Nobody Agrees on Audrey Hepburn. #Shorts
description:
CLICK TO WATCH THE FULL VIDEO 👉 https://youtu.be/eYKsCsG_cDA

October 1966, a village in County Wicklow. A hired car with a broken fan belt, and twenty minutes of waiting in the post office across the road.

Those twenty minutes were described in print twice, twenty-two years apart, by two people who never met. The two accounts agree about the weather and the fan belt and nothing else at all.

This story is a work of fiction. The village, the post office and every detail in it are invented, created for storytelling and not drawn from any record.
